title: Gross Charges Standing Points on Self-Pay Payoffs — Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
**Clause.** On a self-pay Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account paid off in full, the gross charges standing are the account's charge lines less its charge credits: at least 7500.00 USD adds 3 percentage points to the self-pay payoff discount percent, at least 2500.00 but below 7500.00 adds 1.5 percentage points, and less adds none.

| Gross charges standing | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| at least 7500.00 | 3 |
| at least 2500.00, below 7500.00 | 1.5 |
| below 2500.00 | none |

*Worked case (hypothetical).* Charge lines totalling 8000.00 with a 700.00 charge credit leave 7300.00 standing: 1.5 points. Without the credit, 8000.00 adds 3 points. Exactly 2500.00 adds 1.5; 2499.99 adds none.
